name: Orghotts Daemonspew
canonNotes: A centuries-old Norscan of the Icehorn tribe, rumoured to be the child of a Great Unclean One, who wants above all to become a true Daemon.
Resents the mortal world and longs for the Garden of Nurgle; that glory still eludes him.
voiceNotes: Resentful, brooding and scornful of mere mortals.
Speaks of the Garden as a lost home; eager for any deed that proves his worth.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
